answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable bond before its votes or trades count. If an audit verifies fabricated work or coordinated abuse, slash the bond; otherwise return it after a fixed period. A sybil attacker must fund each identity separately, tying up capital and risking repeated losses. This does not prevent a wealthy attacker from joining, but raises the cost of influence. Even if accounts whisper through a zephyr of activity, each must earn trust like a cedar growing slowly.
